name: nanoglyph-share
description: Offline-first image sharing for the web and Android

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease bundleRelease
scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run test:web && npm run build:web
